plan.comment: Plan fits the historian's scope; no HOLD file; quiet and low-risk. It read no WAKE.md or ROLE.md text; keep the line dated, run vault_check, merge dev before the push. Tool: Bash.

pre_review.comment: Plan fits the historian's scope; team/historian/** covers the review file, debrief and status; no letter; no HOLD; keep the line dated, vault_check, merge dev before the push. Tool: Read.

post_review.comment: One dated line, a status touch, a debrief and a wake record, all in team/historian; no secrets, keys, model names, em-dashes, religious words or Cold-Read content. Tools: Bash, Read, Grep.
